scope: Shared Apple Silicon host; native macOS and ARM64 Linux VM on this host. Warm filesystem, no independent physical Linux or cold-device qualification. Linux correctness and retrieval/concurrency use two CPUs/1 GiB with swap disabled; paired ingestion uses two CPUs/8 GiB with swap disabled. A separate candidate ingestion admission check uses two CPUs/1 GiB. Stripping artifacts changes file size, not an established runtime memory improvement.

macos.source_manifest_scope: Tracked Zig/spec files excluding Markdown, JSON, Python and lockfiles; source_head and diff hash cover the tracked revision.

linux.source_manifest_scope: Tracked Zig/spec files excluding Markdown, JSON, Python and lockfiles; source_head and diff hash cover the tracked revision.

limits: Verification limits remain per shard request; coordinator-owned request-wide grants are not implemented.
Writes invalidate whole-generation membership proofs; maintained per-segment source-binding certificates remain future work.
Warm Boolean counts are allocation-free only for supported complete borrowed leaves within the bounded program; other expressions fall back to owned execution.
Posting microbenchmarks use the testing allocator as backing and do not measure production malloc or complete ingestion.
Tracked build allocation, process RSS and node memory allowance are separate quantities.

packaging.scope: Archives constructed from previously qualified unchanged CLI sources, with current documentation. Verifies packaged binary and asset hashes and executes the packaged binary on its native ISA. No upload or release publication.

prior_qualification.explanation: Earlier frozen candidate passed HTTP and paired timings but failed 1-GiB ingestion with ResourceBudgetExceeded; grouped physical-field analysis fixes the retained duplicate _all path. Raw attempts remain local.

shared-field-red.log.explanation: Expected pre-fix ResourceBudgetExceeded regression for simultaneously retained physical fields; final introducer tests cover the repaired path.

memory-projection-locals.log.explanation: Synthetic first-batch reduction: distinct_word fails at offset zero with two documents.

sparse-complement-red.log.explanation: Maximum-document-domain count regression before sparse complement arithmetic; expected work-bound failure is retained as a diagnostic.

review-packaging-wrong-toolchain.log.explanation: Direct packaging cache-probe invocation found Zig 0.16 on PATH; final packaging suite passes with pinned Zig 0.17 and temporary fixtures under the worktree.

retained-candidate-smoke.log.explanation: Unfrozen diagnostic binary used a non-antfly basename; the fixture selected its legacy launcher. Final artifacts use antfly.

retained-candidate-smoke-corrected.log.explanation: Unfrozen standalone smoke found public minimum_should_match rejection; fixed in public lowering and covered by final qualification.

retained-count-diagnostic.log.explanation: Reduced the public threshold rejection before its fix.

current-startup-diagnostic.log.explanation: Preserved the wrong-launcher diagnostic before rerunning with the supported basename.

artifact.scope: Symbolized Debug diagnostic; 8 GiB container with explicit 1 GiB process envelope to preserve the failing 128-MiB build slice while allowing stack symbolization. Not performance qualification.

memory_debug.scope: Pre-fix, unfrozen symbolized diagnostic. The stack identifies prepareTextMapperDocsPublication -> buildTextSegmentsFromProjectionBatch without postings scratch, unlike the previously tested direct sink path. Not timing qualification.

hint_harness_oom.explanation: The test tried to read the entire 1.2-GiB unstripped reference binary into Python after timing. Streaming file_digest avoids exhausting the 1-GiB container. Frozen server binaries are unchanged.

linux_runner.recovery: Runner image was deleted by concurrent workspace cleanup; exit-125 attempts did not launch the server. Rebuilt from hash-pinned requirements and reran qualification.

archive_restoration.scope: Every previously restored historical file checked again after checkout cleanup; original Git blobs remain reachable.

sparse_count_work.scope: Regression work counters with sparse immutable inputs, not end-to-end timing or zero total request cost. Clipping and out-of-domain deletions are covered.

component_postings.scope: Isolated posting accumulator construction and serialization, same tagged layout and binary for reference owned arrays versus inline promotion. The instrumented BudgetAllocator uses std.testing.allocator as backing; timings include testing allocator overhead and are not production heap or complete indexing throughput. Tracked allocations exclude RSS. Serialization digests are asserted equal. Shared Apple Silicon host.
